o: The technology that hosts the node: a container such as Docker, or a VM
A plugin that adds ingress support to the cluster
A kubectl command that starts a Pod
The component that schedules Pods onto nodes
questions.w: Drivers include docker, podman, hyperv, kvm2, qemu, virtualbox and vmware. They decide start-up time, resources and isolation.

questions.q: A LoadBalancer Service shows EXTERNAL-IP pending on minikube. What do you run?
o: minikube tunnel in a separate terminal
minikube stop and start
kubectl delete svc and recreate it with a NodePort
minikube addons disable ingress
questions.w: There is no cloud provider. The tunnel assigns an external IP on your machine and forwards traffic while it runs.

questions.q: Which command prints a URL for a NodePort Service in minikube?
o: minikube service payments --url
minikube ip --service payments
kubectl get nodeport payments
minikube expose payments
questions.w: minikube service handles the driver differences, and may open a tunnel that must stay running.

questions.q: How can you build an image directly inside the minikube cluster?
o: minikube image build, or docker-env then docker build
kubectl build -t payments . run against the minikube context
minikube push payments followed by a registry login to the node
docker build --cluster minikube . using the Docker context flag
questions.w: The cluster has its own runtime. image load copies an image in; image build or docker-env builds it there.

o: Bundled optional components such as ingress, metrics-server and dashboard
Extra worker nodes that you add to a running cluster with one command
Plugins that change the Kubernetes API version used by the cluster
Container images that the kubelet downloads when the node first starts
questions.w: minikube addons enable <name> installs them with one command, a main convenience over a bare cluster.

questions.q: Why does a HorizontalPodAutoscaler show <unknown> for CPU in minikube?
o: metrics-server is not enabled, or the Pods have no CPU requests
The cluster has only one node, and autoscaling needs at least two nodes
The Deployment uses a fixed image tag instead of the latest tag
minikube does not support autoscaling in any of its drivers
questions.w: Enable the metrics-server addon and set CPU requests; the HPA computes utilisation against requests.

questions.q: How can a Pod in minikube reach a database running on your laptop?
o: Through host.minikube.internal, which resolves to the host
Through localhost, which maps to the laptop
Through the Service type ExternalName with no name
Pods cannot reach processes outside the cluster
questions.w: Inside the node, localhost is the node itself. host.minikube.internal resolves to your machine, which must listen on a reachable address.

questions.q: When is minikube a better choice than kind?
o: For a friendly learning cluster with addons, dashboard and tunnel
For creating hundreds of disposable clusters per hour in CI
For running Kubernetes without Docker or any VM driver on Windows
For production workloads that need high availability
questions.w: Both are real Kubernetes. kind is lighter and suits CI; minikube gives more built-in conveniences for learning and development.
